verdict.rationale: Fastmail exposes a full, standards-based JMAP API (session discovery, sync, push, mail send) confirmed by both docs and live runtime probes, and generic API-token/API-doc pages exist, supporting a strong case for API-first parity. However, the evidence pack never explicitly confirms that UI-specific features like Masked Email creation, Snooze, Templates, Scheduled/Undo Send, or Filters & Rules are all exposed via the same JMAP API rather than being UI-only conveniences. missing for 10: explicit API/extension docs mapping each UI feature (masked email, snooze, templates, filters) to JMAP methods, and independent confirmation that automation actually replicates all UI actions.
